requirement: Understand natural room light commands and existing household comfort context without requiring exact technical lamp names.
sourceFindings: The old resolver accepted woonkamer but rejected lampen in de woonkamer.
Inventory did not expose current device/comfort state and denied configured shared-speaker inventory.
Existing overkapping heater switch was absent from effect allowlist.
changes: Resolve existing named light groups, actual rooms and bounded named groups.
Preserve explicit diagnostic light control; omit diagnostic/config entities from group expansion.
Freeze exact group targets; verify all states, no automatic retry of partial or uncertain dispatch.
Expose bounded device and comfort state through existing inventory; no private person/tracker state or shared automation details.
Add exact existing heater switch turn_on/turn_off to core allowlist; no climate operations.
limitations: No physical actuation or spoken/model-driven test.
Understanding an implicit cold complaint is not proven by resolver checks.
checkSetupCorrections: Test used actual disposition field rather than status.
Test engine changed to installed PostgreSQL driver without opening a connection.
Pre-install count command syntax corrected before any service change.
